name: Shennong
summary: Shennong is Hubei Qirobotics’ bipedal humanoid robot family for science education, visitor guidance and industrial logistics. The manufacturer describes high-torque motors developed in house, articulated arms and hands, and a body designed for full humanoid movement. The official WRC 2026 listing establishes the named robot and its manufacturer. Serial production and current delivery availability have not been verified.
